verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago documents its own MP CLI, which lets you operate payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores and reports with a single token and no browser or visual client. That covers the headless half of the story directly, but nothing in the evidence shows CI usage or pipeline automation. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation or examples, non-interactive and scripting guidance (exit codes, output formats), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: With a single token, you can operate payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores, and reports without a browser, visual interface client, or manual HTTP calls.
